assertions.name: favours_published_V3
assertions.source: V3_measured is closer to the published GGM value than to the legacy literal

description: Non-circular measurement of V3 for 5_2 from the Borel-Pade pole map. The reality of V3 (GGM 6.1 keeps only Re V for sigma_3) forces Im(zeta13) = Im V1 = Vol, a constraint mentioning NEITHER candidate; the pole nearest that line fixes V3 = Re V1 - Re(pole), and the two candidate literals are compared only afterwards. Pre-registered gates G0-G3 fixed before the first run; the G3 near-miss is reported, not suppressed. auditOnly; comparison to observed; no fit; nothing wired.

data.verdict: The reality-line pole selection (Im zeta = Vol, mentioning neither candidate) measures V3 = -7.744259484, favouring the published GGM value -7.69319082 over the corpus legacy literal -2.758099029 by 272.3x in relative deviation. Scope-(a): evidence about which V3 the phi_sigma1 series knows; NOT a derivation of the legacy literal's provenance, which remains OPEN. Finite-order Pade, so the ~0.664% residual vs GGM is a truncation artifact, not a discrepancy claim.
